## What Is Incomplete
- No login in V0.1.
- No cloud sync in V0.1.
- No live calendar, GitHub, WordPress, or MicroGrow integration yet.
- No AI assistant in V0.1.

## Current Risks
- Keep the app local-first and offline-first.
- Keep review-first behavior where capture or automation is involved.
- Make one useful slice better at a time.
- Prefer small, safe changes over broad rewrites.
- Park work that is not ready instead of forcing it into the main path.
